claim: No cell is in both the `y` and the `u` set
fix: No cell is in both sets, except where a component wires its own stage-1 port to its own input.
ver_evidence: Probe K6a_v/probe.jl self-wire block: Group((; c = SelfFed()); local_wires = ("c/y" => "c/u",)) builds and runs. Its event entry has u = (u = CellAddr((0,)),) and y = (y = CellAddr((0,)),), the same cell, and the handler saw seen_u = seen_y = 0.3. A stage-1 port wired to its own input is legal, since only an algebraic self-wire is refused (test/test_build.jl:185-191 refuses a stage-2 self-wire as a loop). So one cell can be in both sets.
ver_note: The spec's §5.2 wording (spec.md:1186, 'u is gathered from foreign cells through the wiring') makes the same overstatement. The fix may belong there too, or the design may want to forbid a self-wire. That choice is the user's.

claim: x_projection normalizes the latched stores

ver_evidence: src/executor.jl:456-463: _fire_project! calls entry.projection(entry.comp, reconstruct(XT, xbuf, entry.x_off)) and writes the flat state buffer back. claim: Every library component walks under Dual for linearization and trim.

ver_evidence: Probe lines 4-7: under a Dual activation, retype_entry gives Constant's y as Float64 (pinned, src/library.jl:350), Comparator's y as Bool (Pinned{Bool}), Freeze's y as Float64, and only FirstOrderLag's y walks to Dual. The §7 list leaves out the stepper's carried state, which a restore needs to continue an adaptive run bitwise (test/test_adaptive.jl:116). §12.6 at spec.md:10637 lists it. claim: The layout has compile-time offsets into one contiguous Vector{T}
fix: It computes a flat layout at build time. The layout gives each component a block in one contiguous `Vector{T}` that the framework owns, the [buffer](#g-buffer), at a base offset fixed at build time, and each leaf an offset within its block fixed at compile time.
ver_evidence: The layout's offsets are build-time values held at run time, not compile-time constants. src/build.jl:1480 `x_offs = [first(r) - 1 for r in layout.xblocks]`, stored as a runtime field at src/executor.jl:77 `x_off::Int` and passed as an argument at src/executor.jl:130 `reconstruct($XT, xbuf, entry.x_off)`. Only the leaf offsets inside one component's block are fixed at compile time, by the @generated reconstruct/flatten! (src/leaves.jl:223, src/leaves.jl:388). The buffer is one contiguous Vector{T} (src/build.jl:1417). No log entry uses the term "compile-time offset".
